items.title: The session agent and a relay agent can run together
items.text: Before, only one agent could run per user, so a Mac couldn't keep your panes alive and host its own remote sessions at the same time. Each kind of agent now has its own lock, and a takeover only ever replaces an agent of the same kind, so a relay agent can never kill the process that owns your panes.

items.title: Cleaner shell environments
items.text: The agent no longer passes its own lock settings or device token into the shells it starts.

items.title: Revoked agents stop
items.text: A relay agent running under the app exits once its credential has been revoked, instead of retrying forever with a dead one.
